column1: # Eval labels for the auto PR reviewer. Tab-separated. Lines starting with '#'
# and blank lines are ignored. install.sh copies this to
# ~/.config/auto-pr-review/eval/labels.tsv if that file does not exist yet.
# Columns:  repo <TAB> pr <TAB> sha <TAB> kind <TAB> path <TAB> line <TAB> note
#   sha    the head SHA to replay (the diff is taken as base...sha so the
#   kind   'bug' = a real defect the reviewer SHOULD flag (expected finding)
#          'fp'  = NOT a defect; the reviewer should NOT flag this location
#   path   file path as it appears in findings (repo-relative)
#   line   line number of the issue
#   note   free text, for humans only
# Manual rows go above the marker line that harvest-labels.sh writes; everything
# below that marker is regenerated on each harvest.
